skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding structure and types of international trade correspondence
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the structure and types of international trade correspondence.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Explaining terminology in international trade documents
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to explain terminology used in international trade documents.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the structure of international trade contracts
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the structure of international trade contracts.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will apply laws governing international trade documents and contracts to draft correspondence, documents, and international trade contracts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Enhancing communication skills, working independently, and in teams through group assignments and reading assigned materials
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will enhance their communication skills, work independently, and in teams through group assignments and reading assigned materials.
